assets.note: REPO holds only the model files (gym/decision_transformer/models); it has no environment, dataset or evaluation script that could produce one

unclear: REPO contains only gym/decision_transformer/models (decision_transformer.py, model.py, trajectory_gpt2.py). There is no training loop, loss, dataset loader, environment rollout, target-return setting or return-to-go decrement here, so the draft's dataset, target_return, env, loss and decrement have no code counterpart and are not reported.
Model choice: DecisionTransformer is the only concrete model; TrajectoryModel is its abstract base (forward returns None, None, None) and GPT2Model is its sub-module.
No convolutional state encoder exists in REPO (only the gym code with a linear embed_state), so the draft's conv_encoder has no code counterpart.
forward takes a rewards argument but never uses it (get_action passes None; comment: 'we don't care about the past rewards in this model').

hidden_size, n_layer, n_head, n_ctx, dropout rates, activation function and max_length K are set by the caller or by transformers.GPT2Config defaults, neither of which is in REPO; their values are unknown here.
The causal mask buffer has size n_ctx x n_ctx (GPT2Config.n_ctx, outside REPO); the code does not check that 3K fits within it.

forward always builds 3K tokens including a_K, but a_K's prediction is read from the s_K token, which the causal mask keeps from seeing a_K. What the caller puts in the not-yet-known last action at test time is outside REPO.

GPT2Model also contains a cross-attention path (config.add_cross_attention / encoder_hidden_states), layer truncation (set_layers) and model-parallel code; DecisionTransformer never passes encoder_hidden_states, so these are not drawn.
The discrete-action case (cross-entropy) has no separate head in REPO: predict_action is always Linear(+Tanh) to act_dim.
